products.name: MowRoute Pricer: Per-Stop Cost and Route Density Calculator
products.unique_concept: Prices each lawn stop from its real cost including drive time to the stop, so a far-away property costs more than the one next door, and shows margin per visit and per route-hour.
products.pain_points: Flat neighbourhood pricing ignores drive time
products.pitch_points: Price by true stop cost; keep routes dense; no subscription
features: Cost settings (labor $/hr, equipment/fuel per hour, overhead per hour, target margin)
Stop entry: mow minutes, drive minutes in/out, extras
Price per visit = cost / (1 - margin) and margin at current price
Route builder: total hours, revenue per route-hour, flag low-yield stops
Printable price list, CSV/JSON export, localStorage
products.build_spec: Single-file HTML. stop_cost = (mow_min + drive_min)/60 x (labor + equipment + overhead) ; price = stop_cost/(1-margin); route_yield = sum(price)/sum(hours). Defaults are editable examples; Housecall Pro's ~$52-55 at 30% margin example is cited as a vendor example only. Unit tests + phone width.
